recipe: Qualified 163x153 profiler recipe with only interior-order changed from 3; same prepared schematic and hardware options
decision: Retain order 3 and the qualified 163x153 incumbent. Faster failures are not iteration speed improvements for a successful board.

next_investigation.hypothesis: Each search state solves x and sometimes y independently. States differing only in the opposite axis may repeat identical axis problems. Invocation-local caching keyed by the complete active-axis separation assignment could reuse results without pruning states.
next_investigation.requirements: Preserve cycle provenance indices, exact positions and qualifiers; count only executed solves; record reuse explicitly; bound storage to the existing search invocation; test negative cycles, output-grid rejection and failure receipts before adoption.

limitations: Concurrent single-run diagnostic screens, not timing benchmarks. No physical infeasibility proof, new accepted layout or production policy change.
